item.title: ORBIS acquires Robinson Industries
item.description: Founded in the 1940s and headquartered in Coleman, Mich., Robinson Industries brings decades of thermoforming expertise, including single and twin-sheet thermoforming, sheet extrusion and structural foam injection molding.

item.title: Dairy membrane market gaining momentum as processors invest in advanced filtration
item.description: Market forecasts for 2026 show continued growth in membrane use for dairy product separation, quality and efficiency.

item.title: NOSHOK names Buchanan Midwest regional sales manager
item.description: Buchanan brings more than 30 years of proven sales leadership and territory management experience in industrial manufacturing, motion control, and safety solutions, with a strong track record of driving year-over-year growth and building strategic customer relationships.

item.title: RITZ to premiere star-studded big game ad
item.description: The :30 second commercial opens with Hamm and Yang perched in a treehouse overlooking partygoers who are enjoying RITZ Crackers on the beach.

item.title: Predicting the future for dairy
item.description: Normally, I run my predictions for the upcoming year in January. This year, I'm doing it in February, and I will summarize many of the prediction trends I have seen throughout the industry. Many of the experts have a great story about the future to tell.

item.title: NOSHOK introduces PTI10 and PTI15 Intelligent Pressure Transmitter and Transmitter/ Switch
item.description: The NOSHOK PTI15 Series Transmitter/Switch is replacing the 800 Series Electronic Indicating Pressure Transmitter/Switch and has a reduced price, the company said.

item.title: Oikos to offer Super Bowl ad featuring actress Kathryn Hahn and football pro Derrick Henry
item.description: Oikos, a high-protein yogurt brand of Danone North America, is making its return to football's biggest stage with a new Game Day spot, "The Big Hill." The 30-second ad shows how the protein-packed lineup from Oikos can boldly power the strength it takes to push through life's uphill battles, proving that "Stronger Makes Everything Better."

item.title: Meadow Gold Dairy launches high-protein milk
item.description: Each 64‑ounce jug delivers 15 grams of natural dairy protein per serving from local farms. Meadow Gold Protein launches in whole and 2% reduced‑fat varieties with a suggested retail price of $3.99.

item.title: IDFA executive named CEO of International Bottled Water Association
item.description: With more than 20 years of experience in food and beverage policy, strategic communications, and high-stakes advocacy, Matt Herrick is uniquely qualified to strengthen IBWA’s position as a trusted authority on bottled water’s safety, sustainability, and consumer choice.

item.title: Graeter's introduces Valentine's Day collection
item.description: This month also sees the return of limited time offer flavor Cherry Chip. This February flavor is filled with bright maraschino cherries and Graeter’s signature chocolate chips.
